---
title: "Caption layout"
format: typst
filters:
  - index
---

The fixture for a mark in the caption of a float that Quarto lays out in
cells (M115 review). The filter moves a caption's labels into the float's
content, so that a Typst list of figures does not copy them. Wrapping all of
a laid-out float's content in one block made its cells one cell, so the two
cells below printed one above the other. They must print side by side, on one
line of text, and the mark files this page.

::: {#fig-kestrel layout-ncol=2}
